excludes: real application repositories or confidential workloads
purpose: observe the existing frozen Gate 2A supervisor once, from PostgreSQL's log: whether the gate2a_audit template agrees with a real log, how integer-array parameters log, whether the reader boundary holds, and the role catalog around one supervised run

target.instance_binding: the export's system_identifier and postmaster_start_time; the run batch must see the same values

forbidden_targets.reason: the protected development database: never connected to, never a fallback

credential_source.secret: DATABASE_URL in the git-ignored .env, with only host, port, database, user and password
refused: a target other than the manifest's

model_policy.model_api_key: absent from the environment and from .env; refused otherwise
model_policy.gate2a_settings: built from the fixed target with model_api_key=None

cluster.prerequisite: the test database deployspecter_test exists and is empty of ds_run and ds_char; the operator creates it once (section 2 of the approval document)

container.name: deployspecter-live-pg
container.password: operator-generated, exported as DS_PG_PASSWORD in the shell and in DATABASE_URL in the git-ignored .env; never written to evidence
container.note: memory, cpus, pids-limit and the tmpfs size are additions to Gate 2A's accepted command; they bound resources and need confirming at container start

schema.name: ds_run
schema.time_typed_columns: none (enforced by evidence_binding.check_no_time_types on the pinned export)

parameter_log_model.strings: sent as text; logged as given, single quotes doubled
parameter_log_model.integers_booleans_floats: sent in binary by psycopg 3 (Int2/Int4/Int8, Bool, Float binary dumpers); logged with the type's text output
parameter_log_model.float8: shortest exact decimal (extra_float_digits=1, pinned in session_options): NaN, Infinity, -Infinity, '-0' for negative zero (observed), Python repr for non-integral finite values below 1e15 or in exponent form. Positive zero, integral values and 1e15 <= |x| < 1e16 have no established form and are refused before any SQL runs
parameter_log_model.observed_basis: the third real run's op7b statements, tests/research_tracks/fixtures/gate_a1_v3_observed.csv

client_connection_policy.gate_a2_parent_sessions_and_readers: Gate A1's RealEffects and SegmentEffects: prepare_threshold=None at connect, checked before use
client_connection_policy.proof_boundary: shown from the real frozen code and psycopg's real classes offline: Sandbox.__init__ sends three distinct statements on admin once each (none can be auto-prepared at psycopg's default threshold of 5) and none on monitor; SupervisedRunner.__init__ sends nothing; the property setter sends nothing. Whether the real log shows no prepared harness statement is what this run observes

b2_policy.exception: the supervisor's admin session runs CREATE ROLE and RESET log_statement with log_statement='none'; that interval is UNOBSERVABLE
b2_policy.observations: reconciled read-only role-catalog reads (op0p, statement set op0p_role_catalog) in the reader segments before and after the sandbox bootstrap and the supervised call; never inside Gate 2A's protected window
b2_policy.permitted_claim: the observed role-catalog states meet the stated before/after conditions, subject to what the catalog shows
limitations: never proves the SQL or the temporary role's attributes inside the interval
a change made and undone inside the interval is undetectable
a clean final catalog is not proof of correct intermediate execution
the role's password or verifier is never observed
b2_policy.option_b: a separately reviewed supervisor revision (GATE_A2_2_SUPERVISOR_AUDIT.md section 4); not implemented

gate2a_audit.never_classified_all_sql_audited_while: any claim is UNOBSERVABLE or NOT_TESTED
gate2a_audit.plain_serial: refused by SegmentedRun: its result carries no run id or registered sessions

steps: OP-1 operator: start a fresh disposable container and create deployspecter_test with Gate A1's reviewed commands (plan prints them); the driver runs no command
segment 0: op0p preflight (Gate A1's statements), op0p role catalog
gap 1: Sandbox construction from the fixed target; B5 option 1 on its admin and monitor sessions
segment 1: op0p role catalog; op0r seeded reset; op6i typed check; op6f typed read (verified initial digest)
gap 2: exactly one SupervisedRunner.run of the pinned scenario with schedule a, b
segment 2: op0p role catalog; op6f final read; op9c cleanup; whole-batch line completeness
OP-7 operator: copy the server log for the evidence, then docker stop deployspecter-live-pg

expected_results.VERIFIED: every admin template phase except role creation, matched exactly; reader boundaries in both gaps; child sessions and Gate 2A's own reconciliation; the log-derived seed equals the manifest's initial_rows; snapshot ordering; the supervisor's initial snapshot equals the verified digest; the final read equals the supervisor's final snapshot; the role-catalog before/after conditions; the unlogged interval bounded by consecutive admin log lines; line completeness
expected_results.UNOBSERVABLE: role creation (B2); the snapshot values; the state between the snapshot and the worker; the run role inside the interval; what the runner-role DO block executed; container start, initdb and the operator's CREATE DATABASE
expected_results.REFUTED: any deviation from the template, an unattributed session, a prepared harness statement, a reader present at the sweep, a residual role, membership, setting or privilege, or a final read that disagrees
expected_results.INDETERMINATE: a stopped call, a missing observation or marker, an incomplete flush
expected_results.NOT_TESTED: after this run: Option A's catalog checks across more than one run, Option B, plain_serial attribution, the DROP/ALTER path of the prepared-name model
expected_results.separation: log-template agreement (what the admin session sent) is reported separately from database state (what the reconciled parent reads saw); neither stands in for the other

stop_conditions: any refused precondition (model credential, libpq variable, credential source, target)
any parent session that doesn't reconcile
the B5 policy failing on either harness session
any REFUTED or INDETERMINATE claim in a gap
the Gate 2A call raising or being flagged
on_stop: one read-only role-catalog observation from the new segment, then the coverage record, then failure.json; nothing is retried; the operator stops the container
artifacts: gate2a_coverage.json (claims, role catalog, B2 interval, calls, segments)
secret_handling: the password lives only in the git-ignored .env as DATABASE_URL
MODEL_API_KEY and every PG* variable absent
no evidence file may contain the password; the operator checks after the run
the run role's verifier is generated by Gate 2A and kept out of the log by B2's interval
teardown: docker stop deployspecter-live-pg (the container was started with --rm, tmpfs storage)
confirm port 55433 is free and deployspecter-pg (55432) untouched

approval.requirement: a new approval file naming this manifest's SHA-256 and the phase, signed by the owner with their SSH key and checked against allowed_signers; no earlier approval is valid
